EOS ships three separate downloads - desktop, Android and iOS. They are different releases of
different shapes and are not interchangeable, so each gets its own directory here.

Every tree below is a verbatim extraction of the vendor download. Nothing is copied, moved or renamed
afterwards. The one exception is the line marked (*), which is iOS-only and must be built by hand.
See README.md section 2.1 for the command.


EOS (desktop: Windows / Linux / Mac) should have the tree:

EOS-------SDK-------Bin
            |
            --------Include
            |
            --------Lib


EOS (Android) is a separate, AAR-based download placed alongside the desktop SDK:

EOS-------SDK-Android-------Include
              |
              -------------Bin----Android----static-stdc++----aar    (eossdk-StaticSTDC-release.aar)
              |
              -------------Tools                                     (dev auth tool; unused by build)

Nothing is linked or staged on Android - the AAR is packaged into the APK by EOS_Android_UPL.xml and
dlopen()'d by name at runtime.


EOS (iOS) is a separate, framework-based download. Note there is NO Include/ on this platform:

EOS-------SDK-IOS-------Bin----EOSSDK.framework----Headers   (the iOS headers live in here)
                          |
                          ----EOSSDK.xcframework
                          |
                          ----EOSSDK.embeddedframework.zip   (*) built by hand

The iOS SDK keeps its headers inside the framework. The build points the include path straight at
Bin/EOSSDK.framework/Headers rather than copying them out to look like the other platforms, so an
SDK upgrade is just a re-extract with nothing to fix up afterwards.

(*) UBT needs the framework as a zip laid out EOSSDK.embeddedframework/EOSSDK.framework, which the
    download does not contain - wrap and zip it yourself. The framework is repackaged, not modified.
    Without the zip the build errors with "EOS iOS framework missing" and EOS is left out entirely.


Steamworks (desktop only - no Android or iOS backend) should have the tree:

Steamworks----sdk------public
                |
                -------redistributable_bin
                |
                ...
